notes.title: Final Approval Given...
notes.notes:
The game's build was approved so we are in the driver's seat of polishing up the rest of it to get it ready for release. There should be no delay from our November 10th release date (12:00 pm Pacific Time.)

Some notes about the game:

Game transitions between screens (uses screens instead of scrolling on this title)

Full game has 228 screens in the full world. We are estimating total game play time (if players do everything) to be between 2 and 3 hours.

Full Retail price of the game will be $1.99 but we expect to offer a launch discount to encourage "Early Bird" purchases.

If you have any questions or comments, feel free to post on the community discussions. I will monitor them regularly and try to provide as timely of feedback as possible.

I encourage you to wishlist before launch if you wish to buy at a discount so you will be alerted at launch since we are offering a launch discount. We want you to save money too!

I am quite sure that you will feel you got your "less than two dollars worth" when you play this game. It is a bargain!

Sincerely,
Matthew (Developer)
